scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server
